macros.name: pdfcolIfStackExists
macros.doc: Macro \pdfcolIfStackExists checks whether color stack ⟨name⟩ exists.

macros.name: pdfcolInitStack
macros.doc: A new color stack is initialized by \pdfcolInitStack.

macros.name: pdfcolSetCurrent
macros.doc: Macro \pdfcolSetCurrent sets the color that is read in the top-most entry of color stack ⟨name⟩.
